holdings.thesis: HOLD: shares eased slightly to ~$418 (from ~$411-448 post-earnings range) after the 9/2 Q2 FY27 print (record revenue $384M, gross margin 19.3%, record net income $53M, record adjusted EBITDA $70M, Power segment +53% YoY) -- a normal pullback after the initial pop, not a reversal. Still down -32.0% vs. cost basis on stop-loss review, but that's a legacy of the original entry price, not new deterioration; position stays small (3.1% of portfolio) after two prior stop-loss trims and no new negative catalyst emerged today.

HOLD: shares ~$171, roughly flat with yesterday, three trading days past the Q1 FY27 guidance-miss/margin-compression selloff (GAAP gross margin fell to 64.5% from 68.2%). BofA cut its PT to $275 (from $340, kept Buy) reflecting the same known event -- no fresh negative data today. FY27 guidance still implies 85%+ revenue growth; position (5.4% of portfolio) was already de-risked via two trims on 8/31 and 9/2, so holding the smaller remaining stake rather than trimming further absent new information.

HOLD: thesis intact and strengthening -- DA Davidson raised its PT to $175 (kept Buy) on top of Evercore's 9/1 upgrade to Outperform/$210, both citing strong product/monetization momentum (DAUs +23% YoY to 58.7M, paid subscribers +17%). The earnings-growth-decline flag remains attributable to AI-feature reinvestment, not demand weakness. Position is at 14.9% of portfolio, just under the 15% max_position_pct cap -- watching for a forced trim if price appreciates further, not trimming today since it hasn't breached the cap.

HOLD: shares roughly flat at ~$55.66, no new insider-selling Form 4s beyond what's already reflected in the two prior trims (~85% combined reduction). CEO succession plan (President Rahul Singhal to CEO, founder Jack Abuhoff to Executive Chairman effective 9/30/26) remains previously-known information, not a new catalyst. Position is minimal (1.4% of portfolio); will revisit if the transition date brings new developments.

HOLD: thesis intact -- Vertiv acquired Strategic Thermal Labs (9/2) adding liquid-cooling expertise for high-density AI/HPC data centers, an incremental positive, and declared its regular $0.0625 quarterly dividend. The Hagens Berman/Pomerantz securities-fraud investigations tied to the 7/29 Q2 guidance miss remain a known, unchanged overhang, not new information. No further trim warranted beyond the two already taken (8/31, 9/1).

HOLD: thesis intact. Waymo announced plans for its first fully autonomous robotaxi service in the EU (Munich, targeting commercial launch by end of 2027) -- an incremental positive optionality story on top of the core Search/Cloud/AI case (Gemini 3.8 Flash rollout, Berkshire's Abel calling Alphabet a 'significant AI player'). Stock went ex-dividend ($0.22) today as scheduled; the known DOJ/FTC regulatory overhangs are unchanged, not new negative information.

HOLD: shares down ~11% from August's all-time high and have broken below the 100-day moving average, but the driver remains the already-known FTC ad-pricing lawsuit (filed 9/1), not new deterioration. Rosenblatt maintained Buy with a $335 PT, and Q2 results (revenue +20% YoY constant-currency, operating margin 13.7% vs. 11.4% a year ago, AWS growth trajectory toward 45% by year-end) still support the thesis.

HOLD: thesis intact, no new catalyst today beyond yesterday's Piper Sandler PT raise to $185. Q3 dividend of $1.03/share is payable 9/10 to holders of record; 10 analysts rate Buy, 0 Sell, average PT $170.91. Geopolitical tensions continue supporting oil prices.

HOLD: thesis strengthening further -- a broad wave of price-target raises followed the FQ4 beat (revenue +33% YoY to $1.17B, GMV +36% to $14.1B): Goldman Sachs to $115, Bernstein to $110, Truist to $85, plus JPMorgan/BofA/Susquehanna/BMO/Cantor/Needham/RBC all raising targets. Fiscal Q1 guidance of $1.19-1.22B revenue tops the $1.16B consensus. No new negative data today.

HOLD: shares roughly stable around $213, no new catalyst today. Q2 results already reflected in price (EPS $0.13 vs $0.008 YoY, revenue $1.12B +36% YoY, both beats) with FY26 revenue-growth guidance raised to 30%. The known OpenAI spend-deceleration flag from the Q2 call remains the driver of the post-earnings pullback, not new information; AI-observability demand thesis intact.

HOLD: thesis intact. JPMorgan maintained Buy with a $1,400 PT; new Phase 1 inflammation candidate LY5625575 adds early pipeline optionality alongside the core GLP-1 franchise and pending $2.88B Merida Biosciences acquisition. Stock ~$1,149, off its $1,280 all-time closing high but no negative catalyst -- 20-analyst Buy consensus intact.

HOLD: thesis strengthening -- Piper Sandler initiated Overweight with a $22 PT, adding to Scotiabank's Outperform/$25 initiation, both citing the high-growth capital-light platform model. Kraken/Payward stablecoin partnership remains the known catalyst. CEO fireside chat at Goldman's Communacopia conference on 9/8 is a near-term watch item; no new negative data today.

HOLD: thesis intact and strengthening -- shares trading just below recent highs on record Q2 results and a swelling $72B backlog reflecting AI-linked power demand. A recent rating upgrade to Strong Buy reflects a 10.7% rise in earnings estimates over the past three months; FieldAI physical-AI/robotics partnership remains the known incremental positive. No new negative data today.

HOLD: thesis intact. Record Q2 2026 revenue growth of 287% YoY continues to be the core support for the position; the Oxford Ionics acquisition ($1.075B, closed) advances the chip-scale ion-trap manufacturing roadmap. Company remains loss-making with a $254.7M six-month operating loss, a known risk already reflected in the modest 2.3% position sizing. The 9/30/26 public-warrant expiration remains the known near-term dilution watch item; no new negative developments today.
